card.name: Setup for negative causes or setbacks
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words that lead into a negative reason or setback, such as "due to", "and weaker", "has faced", "sales were poor". Found in history and business news about decline, damage or failure.

modes.label: Due to
modes.description: The word "to" after "due" introducing a cause of decline or failure.
modes.example: the Assyrian Empire began to unravel due<< to>> a series of bitter civil wars

modes.label: Verbs and adjectives of hardship
modes.description: A word like faced, poor, weaker or been that is about to be followed by a bad outcome.
modes.example: the city has often<< faced>> severe infrastructural damage, most recently due

modes.label: Joining negative factors
modes.description: A joining word inside a list of problems.
modes.example: because a difficult financing climate<< and>> weaker “regulatory” support in the
